descriptionByLocale.it:
GHOL è l'ospedale regionale di riferimento per l'Occidente tedesco con le sue strutture a Nyon e Rolle. Unisciti a noi è l'opportunità di lavorare quotidianamente con più di 900 dipendenti per garantire la salute e il benessere dei pazienti e delle loro famiglie. Descrizione della posizione: Al fine di rafforzare il nostro team di terapeuti STROKE UNIT, stiamo cercando un logopedista motivato per intervenire con pazienti adulti acutamente ricoverati. Integrerai un team dinamico di circa 20 terapeuti sul sito di Nyon (logisti, terapisti e fisioterapisti del lavoro) lavorando in stretta collaborazione con team medici e sanitari. Nell'ambito della vostra attività, sarete principalmente tenuti a:
• Condurre valutazioni logopediche in pazienti adulti con disturbi di discorso, comunicazione e discorso.
• Partecipa alla proiezione e alla valutazione della disfagia, nonché alle raccomandazioni per il cibo e la deglutizione sicura.
• Assicurare la gestione precoce e avviare i trattamenti logopedici nella fase acuta.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con medici, infermieri e altri professionisti ospedalieri.
• Partecipare a simposi interdisciplinari e contribuire alla continuità del percorso di cura.
• Traccia le tue procedure nel file del paziente computerizzato.
• Partecipare alla formazione dei caregiver Profilo richiesto:
• Esperienza clinica con un'indispensabile popolazione adulta, soprattutto nelle aree di lingua, discorso e ingoia.
• Applicazioni da giovani laureati sono benvenuti, a condizione che abbiano una significativa esperienza di stage con gli adulti.
• Interessi nel lavoro ospedaliero acuto e nella cura precoce.
• Interessi nella formazione neurologica
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre godendo la collaborazione interprofessionale.
• Senso organizzativo, flessibilità e eccellenti capacità relazionali. Livello di formazione:
• Master in logopedia o diploma equivalente riconosciuto dalla Croce Rossa svizzera (richiesto). Vantaggi: All'interno di GHOL, svilupperai le tue competenze attraverso una vera politica di formazione continua e l'opportunità di beneficiare di una ricca collaborazione interdisciplinare con i vari operatori sanitari. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro interessanti (localizzazione, nuovo ospedale, spirito di squadra, supporto da un rispondente clinico). Ti interessa questa sfida? Allora mandaci la tua domanda!
descriptionByLocale.en:
GHOL is the regional reference hospital for the German West with its structures in Nyon and Rolle. Joining us is an opportunity to work daily with more than 900 employees to ensure the health and well-being of patients and their families. Description of position: In order to strengthen our team of STROKE UNIT therapists, we are looking for a motivated logopedist to intervene with acutely hospitalized adult patients. You will integrate a dynamic team of about 20 therapists on the Nyon site (logists, occupational therapists and physiotherapists) working in close collaboration with medical and healthcare teams. As part of your activity, you will be mainly required to:
• Conduct logopedic evaluations in adult patients with speech, communication and speech disorders.
• Participate in the screening and evaluation of dysphagia, as well as recommendations for food and safe swallowing.
• Ensure early management and initiate logopedic treatments in the acute phase.
• Work closely with doctors, nurses and other hospital professionals.
• Participate in interdisciplinary symposia and contribute to the continuity of the care path.
• Trace your procedures in the computerized patient file.
• Participate in the training of caregivers Profile required:
• Clinical experience with an indispensable adult population, especially in the areas of language, speech and swallowing.
• Applications from young graduates are welcome, provided they have a significant experience of internships with adults.
• Interest in acute hospital work and early care.
• Interest in neurological training
• Ability to work independently while enjoying interprofessional collaboration.
• Organizational sense, flexibility and excellent relational skills. Level of training:
• Master in logopedia or equivalent diploma recognized by the Swiss Red Cross (required). Benefits: Within GHOL, you will develop your skills through a real policy of continuing training and the opportunity to benefit from a rich interdisciplinary collaboration with the various healthcare providers. You will benefit from attractive working conditions (localization, new hospital, team spirit, support from a clinical respondent). Interested in this challenge? Then send us your application!
descriptionByLocale.de:

Die Teilnahme an uns ist eine Gelegenheit, täglich mit mehr als 900 Mitarbeitern zu arbeiten, um die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden der Patienten und ihrer Familien zu gewährleisten. Sie werden ein dynamisches Team von etwa 20 Therapeuten auf dem Nyon-Standort integrieren (Logiker, Ergotherapeuten und Physiotherapeuten), die in enger Zusammenarbeit mit medizinischen und Gesundheitsteams arbeiten. Im Rahmen Ihrer Tätigkeit werden Sie hauptsächlich aufgefordert:
• Führen Sie logopädische Untersuchungen bei erwachsenen Patienten mit Sprach-, Kommunikations- und Sprachstörungen durch.
• Beteiligen Sie sich am Screening und der Bewertung von Dysphagie sowie an Empfehlungen für Lebensmittel und sicheres Schlucken.
• Gewährleistung eines frühzeitigen Managements und Einleitung von logopädischen Behandlungen in der akuten Phase.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ärzten, Krankenschwestern und anderen Krankenhausfachkräften zusammen.
• Nehmen Sie an interdisziplinären Symposien teil und tragen Sie zur Kontinuität des Pflegewegs bei.
• Verfolgen Sie Ihre Verfahren in der computerisierten Patientenakte.
• Teilnahme an der Ausbildung von Betreuern Profil erforderlich:
• Klinische Erfahrung mit einer unverzichtbaren erwachsenen Bevölkerung, insbesondere in den Bereichen Sprache, Sprache und Schlucken.
• Bewerbungen von jungen Absolventen sind willkommen, sofern sie über umfangreiche Erfahrungen mit Praktika mit Erwachsenen verfügen.
• Interesse an akuter Krankenhausarbeit und frühzeitiger Pflege.
• Interesse am neurologischen Training
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit zu genießen.
• Organisatorischer Sinn, Flexibilität und ausgezeichnete Beziehungsfähigkeiten. Ausbildungsniveau:
• Master in Logopedia oder gleichwertige Diplom vom Schweizerischen Roten Kreuz anerkannt (erforderlich). Leistungen: Innerhalb von GHOL entwickeln Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten durch eine echte Weiterbildungspolitik und die Möglichkeit, von einer reichen interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Gesundheitsdienstleistern zu profitieren. Sie profitieren von attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen (Lokalisierung, neues Krankenhaus, Teamgeist, Unterstützung durch einen klinischen Befragten). Interesse an dieser Challenge? Dann senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung!

descriptionByLocale.en:

You will actively contribute to the quality of patient care. Description of the post: In your new role, your tasks will include:
• Provide physical and telephone reception for the patient
• Manage medical agenda and appointment making
• Build and maintain medical records
• Organize additional examinations and external appointments
• Ensuring medical and administrative correspondence
• Review and complete referrals of consultation reports and medical correspondence
• Invoicing and administrative tracking of files
• Provide exchanges with insurance, treating physicians and other health partners Profile required: We are convinced of your rapid success in your future functions thanks to your:
• Excellent relational skills and hospitality
• Organizational sense, autonomy, rigour and ability to manage priorities
• High capacity for empathy and ability to manage complex situations with tact and professionalism
• First successful work experience
• Excellent mastery of oral and written French and medical terminology
• Good command of English to communicate with an English patient
• Good mastery of computer tools and medical secretarial software
• Knowledge of Swiss medical billing, an asset
• Ability to build trust with patients

Benevolent with patients, your empathy is recognized by your previous employers. Skilled with IT tools, you are open to change, the introduction of new IT tools for the entire profession does not scare you. Finally, your emotional stability allows you to evolve serenely in a specialty faced with sometimes delicate situations. Level of training:
• Diploma of medical secretary Benefits: You are responsible for the administrative management of the office of Dr. Bloch, a specialist in haematology. Your office is located within the Nyon Hospital, in a valuable working environment and you collaborate daily with the teams of other private offices and with the nursing team. Finally, by joining Dr Bloch's private medical office, you will benefit from the benefits of the collective agreement for the parapublic health sector (CCT-San), as well as from the benefits offered to the employees of the GHOL: staff restaurant, institutional events, discounts to various providers in the region etc... You recognize yourself in this profile and want to join a human-sized firm offering a stimulating work environment? We look forward to receiving your application.
